map.按压力容器规范，由设计压力、工作压力、材料抗拉/屈服强度、容器内径与壁厚，计算试: Per pressure vessel codes, compute the test pressure, hold time, burst pressure, and safety margin from the design pressure, working pressure, material tensile and yield strength, vessel inner diameter, and wall thickness, supporting pressure tests and safety assessment.
map.试验压力 Pt = Pd × 系数（液压 1.25 / 气压 1.15）；爆破压: Test pressure Pt = Pd × coefficient (hydraulic 1.25 / pneumatic 1.15); burst pressure Pb = 2·t·σb·φ ÷ (Di + t − t/10); safety factor n = Pb ÷ Pd; yield pressure Py = 2·t·σs·φ ÷ (Di + t); test stress = Pd·coefficient·(Di+t) ÷ (2·t·φ); hold time by inner diameter: ≤300 mm → 10/5 min, ≤1000 mm → 20/10 min, larger → 30/15 min
map.压力容器耐压试验与安全评定：试验压力按设计压力乘系数（液压试验 1.25、气压试: Pressure vessel pressure testing and safety assessment: the test pressure is the design pressure times a coefficient (hydraulic 1.25, pneumatic 1.15, chosen for safety), and hold time is tiered by vessel inner diameter. Burst pressure uses the thin-wall cylinder formula with wall thickness, tensile strength, and weld coefficient; dividing by the design pressure gives the safety factor (generally ≥3.0 to pass). Yield pressure uses the same formula with yield strength, and the ratio of test stress to yield strength shows whether the test condition enters the plastic range.
map.压力容器出厂耐压试验：由设计压力确定试验压力与保压时间，编制试验方案。: Factory pressure testing of pressure vessels: set the test pressure and hold time from the design pressure and prepare the test plan.
map.在役容器安全评定：由材料强度与壁厚估算爆破压力与安全系数，判断剩余安全裕度。: In-service vessel safety assessment: estimate the burst pressure and safety factor from material strength and wall thickness to judge the remaining safety margin.
map.试验工况应力校核：计算试验压力下的筒体应力与屈服强度之比，判断是否进入塑性。: Test condition stress check: compute the shell stress under test pressure relative to the yield strength to see whether it becomes plastic.
map.内径 800 mm 容器液压试验评定: Hydraulic test assessment for a vessel with 800 mm inner diameter
map.：设计压力 1.6 MPa、工作压力 1.5 MPa、材料抗拉强度 510 MP: : design pressure 1.6 MPa, working pressure 1.5 MPa, material tensile strength 510 MPa, yield strength 345 MPa, inner diameter 800 mm, wall thickness 10 mm, weld coefficient 0.85; for a hydraulic test the test pressure = 1.6 × 1.25 = 2.0 MPa and an inner diameter ≤1000 mm gives a 20 min hold; burst pressure ≈ 2×10×510×0.85 ÷ (800+10−1) ≈ 10.7 MPa, safety factor ≈ 10.7 ÷ 1.6 ≈ 6.7 (≥3.0, pass); yield pressure ≈ 7.24 MPa; test stress ≈ 95.3 MPa, about 27.6% of the yield strength, so it stays elastic.
map.试验压力系数为什么液压比气压高？: Why Is the Test Pressure Coefficient Higher for Hydraulic Than Pneumatic?
map.液压试验取 1.25、气压试验取 1.15。气压试验储存的弹性能大、破裂时危害更: Hydraulic uses 1.25 and pneumatic 1.15. Pneumatic tests store more elastic energy and rupture more dangerously, so the coefficient is set slightly lower to control risk, together with stricter safety protection and isolation requirements.
map.安全系数多少算合格？: What Safety Factor Counts as Passing?
map.按薄壁圆筒公式估算的爆破压力与设计压力之比一般要求 ≥3.0，工具依此判定合格与: The ratio of thin-wall cylinder burst pressure to design pressure is generally required to be ≥3.0, and the tool judges pass/fail on that basis. Real assessment should also combine weld inspection, corrosion allowance, and code requirements.
map.保压时间怎么确定？: How Is the Hold Time Determined?
